title: gf2-core library coverage to 90%
description:
Add targeted tests so gf2-core library line coverage reaches at least 90%.

## Background

Post-exclusion, gf2-core library coverage is 89.5% — about 162 covered lines short of 90%. The highest-yield under-covered library modules are `field/ple.rs` (469 uncov, 70%), `field/inverse.rs` (264 uncov, 72%), `field/charpoly.rs` (176 uncov), `field/winograd.rs` (114 uncov), and `field/expr.rs` (277 uncov, 78%).

## Success Criteria

- [ ] `[hard]` REQ-1: gf2-core library line coverage is at or above 90.0% under the post-exclusion measurement.
- [ ] `[hard]` REQ-2: New coverage concentrates on the under-tested `field/` modules above and exercises real behaviour (correctness against known results or property invariants), not contrived line-touching.
- [ ] `[hard]` REQ-3: All added tests are deterministic and complete within the fast-tier per-test budget; any exceeding it carries an ignore marker per project convention.

## Notes

`gfp/simd_ops.rs` (273 uncov) is SIMD-feature-gated and out of scope — do not target it. Word-boundary edge cases (0, 1, 63, 64, 65 bits) are the project's standard coverage targets for bit-packed structures.
